text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship. Taiki Shuttle, who had
long declared her intention to challenge this race—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees, victory!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Scoring a brilliant victory in the GⅡ race right beforehand,
they rode in with unstoppable momentum.
However, we also—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everything we could do is done...
I gave it my all, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's go. In the Twinkle Series,
I'll finally face Taiki for the first time!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's take up the challenge head-on!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Accept the challenge... Yes, career-wise,
I have the edge. But—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"I don't feel that way... at all.
I know her strength better than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was sure Taiki Shuttle would be full of competitive fire.
Or so I thought...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Pearl-san...
I, I heard...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You said your throat was feeling a little bad.
Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Since I had the chance, I really wanted to run when I was feeling better, yes...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you looking out for me, Taiki?
Thank you. But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry.
No, quite the opposite, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't be happier.
Being able to run alongside you like this.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...What?
I can barely catch my breath... Whyyyy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a fierce, dazzling glint in Seeking the Pearl's eyes
unlike anything seen before.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone tries to play it safe.
Content to stay within the bounds of their own abilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I wasn't allowed to have that.
A ridiculous streak of bad luck was thrown right at me."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yet precisely because of that, a new realm of possibility opened up!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A new way of running! New tactics!
She told me to run with a newfound resolve!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And that is the truth!
What it truly means to 'run.'"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: In the truest sense...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, simply going with the flow and living "naturally"
isn't truly living at all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the finite is the infinite! The limited
is the unlimited! And illness is our wings!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I remade and polished myself just as I envisioned. All so I could run with you, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: "Don't you think it would be far more wonderful if that same me surpassed you, rather than just winning by circumstance?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san... I don't really... underSTAND.
But...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I only understand one thing!
That Pearl-san is full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's no doubt about it.
So come at me without holding anything back.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"And at the same time... I intend to wager
something precious on this match."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you're completely outmatched by her
and get swallowed up in the pack—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'm the end... It means I don't have the strength to take on the world. Yes, this is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—It's a test.
For the new me, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She turns her slightly sorrowful eyes toward me.
As her trainer, I must deliver an objective judgment
on her run today.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, of course! I don't have
the slightest intention of surrendering here!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Taiki! Let us enjoy our full potential
to the fullest♪
Upon this stage of stardom!
